source: Dealing with Money
target: Okukwasaganya sente

source: Whether a lot or very little – everyone has money. The topic is constantly present. We earn money, go shopping, look at prices, and decide if something is worth a certain price for us: every day we need to make decisions about what to do with the money we have.
target: Obanga nyinji oba ntononyo- buly'omu ayina sente.Tufuna sente, netugenda okugula ebintu, tutunulira emiwendo era netusalawo obanga ekintu ekimu kigwanira omuwendo ogo kuffe: bulilunaku twetaga okukola okusalawo ku kiki kyetwetaga okukozesa sente zetuyina.

source: It’s important to remember: Money is a tool. With the same banknote I can bring blessing or harm. We’re responsible for what we do with our money and possessions – God will hold us accountable for what He has entrusted to us.
target: Kikulunyo okujukira: Sente kikozesebwa. N'akapapula ako kekamu akabanka nsobola okuleta omukisa oba obulabe. Tuyina obuvunanyizibwa kukiki tyetukozesa ne sente zaffe era n'ebyo byetulina- Katonda agya kutukwata ab'obuvunayizibwa kulw'ekyo ky'atwegisiza.

source: Jesus talked very often about money. Back then, as well as today, there is the same question: How can we deal properly with money? In His time there wasn’t much technology and dealing with money was not as convenient as it is now. But the core of it is still the same: Money reveals our motivation. It shows what truly matters to us.
target: Yesu yayogera nyo ku sente.Mukisera ekyo era nga munakuzino,waliwo ekibuzo kyekimu: Tuyinzatutya okukwasaganya sente obulunji? Mubisera Bye tekinoloje teyali munji nyo era enkwasaganya ya sente teyali nga bw'eli kati. Naye ekinyusi kikyali kyekimu: Sente ziyolesa ebigendelerwa byaffe. Zelaga ekituffu muffe kyetufako.

source: Looking at our hearts
target: Okutunulira emitima gyaffe

source: We can use the topic of money like a mirror and look for harmful things inside of us:
target: Tusobola okukozesa omulamwa gwa sente nga endabilwamu okumanya ebintu eby'obulabe muffe:

source: Selfishness
target: Obunakyemalira

source: We revolve around ourselves. “It’s all mine! I’m not sharing anything!”
target: Twemalilira nyo ffekanafeka."Nga tugamba, byonna byange! siyina kyengabana kyonna!"

source: Envy and greed
target: Obuuja n'omululu

source: We’re not satisfied with what we have. We compare ourselves with others and think, “He has something better than I have! I want it as well!”
target: Tetukusidwa n'ekyo kyetuyina. Twegelageranya n'abalala netulowoza nti, "Ayinna ekisinga kunzekyenyina! Nkyetaga nange!"

source: Arrogance
target: Obubambavu

source: “I’m better than others. Look at me!”
target: "Nsingako kubalala. Mutunulile!"

source: Worry and fear
target: Obwelalikilivu n'okutya

source: “I don’t have enough. How will I survive if … ?”
target: "Siyina kimala. N'awonawo ntya singa...?"

source: Which of these do you find in your heart? Ask God for forgiveness.
target: Kiiki kubinno ebili mumutima go? Saaba Katonda okusonyiyibwa.

source: Be fair
target: Beela mwenkanya

source: With money comes temptation. Whether at work, with neighbors and friends, or when paying taxes to the government: There are ways to deceive others. Some are obviously illegal, others are in a grey zone, and some ways may be legal but still unfair. But Jesus never deceived people and clearly said, “Do to others as you want them to do to you,” (Luke 6:31) and “the worker deserves his wages” (Luke 10:7).
target: Ku sente kujilako okukemebwa. Oba kumulimu, nebalilwana bo oba n'emikwano, oba nga osasula omusolo eri gavumenti: Waliwo engeri ez'okulimba abalala. Abamu bo bamenyi b'amateka,abalala tebategelekeka,era nengeri endara zisobola okubera mumateka naye nga sizabwenkanya.Naye Yesu teyalimbako ku bantu era mubulambulukufu yagamba,"Kolera abalala ekyo kyoyagala bakukolere,"(Lukka 6:31) era "omukozi agwanira ky'akolede"(Lukka 10:7).

source: When we deceive another person, the harm to that person is often obvious, so we might be more reluctant to deceive them. However, when it’s a big company or our government, we may have less inhibitions. Still, wrong remains wrong.
target: Bwetulimba omuntu omulara, obulumi obujja eri omuntu oyo busubilwa, n'olw'ekyo tw'esulilayo gwanagamba okubalimba.Newamkubade singa ebeera kampane nga neene oba gavumenti yaffe, tusobola okubera n'ebitukugira bitinni. Naye, ekikyamu kisigara kikyamu.

source: God, where have I treated others unfairly? Where have I violated or bypassed laws?
target: Katonda, Ludawa wempisiliza abalala mubutari bwenkanya? Ludawa wenyononede oba wempitide ku mateka?

source: What do I do with my money?
target: Kiki kyenkola ne sente zange?

source: God wants us to deal responsibly with our money and be good stewards of what He entrusts to us. That means:
target: Katonda ayagara tukwasaganye sente zaffe n'obuvunanyizibw era tubere abantu abeesigwa n'ekyo ky'atwesigisa. Ekyo kitegeza:

source: knowing where my finances go (using an account book, budget app, etc.)
target: okumanya sente zange gyezigenda (osobola okukozesa akatabo akenbaliliro, omukutu nga gwambaliliro, n'ebilara.)

source: being diligent and using wisely what He’s entrusting to me
target: okufayo era n'okukozesa obulunji ekyo ky'anesigisiza

source: not being wasteful
target: obutamala gakozesa nga bwosanga

source: asking God what goals I should work for
target: okwebuza ku Katonda ebilubililwa byenyina okukolelera

source: It’s important to be careful and wise to not end up in unhealthy dependencies with our finances (see Romans 13:8). There can be good reasons to incur debts: bigger goals such as starting a company or building a house may only be possible that way. But there are also many bad reasons to incur debts. For example: I compare myself with others and I really want a more amazing holiday or the newest thing from the adverts which I actually can’t afford.
target: Kyamugaso nyo okwegendeleza era n'okubera omugezi obutakomekeleza kwesiga byanfuna okusukuluma (Abaluumi 13:8). Wayinza okuberawo ensonga enunji okugwa mumabaja: ebilubilirwa ebinene nga okutandika kampuni oba okuzimba enyumba kiyinza kusoboka mungeri eyo yokka. Naye waliwo engeri endala nyinji ezokugwa mumabanja enkyamu. Eky'okulabirako: Negelageranya kubalala eranga njagala oluwumula olusuffu oba ekintu ekipya kyendabye ku bulango kyesisobora nakwetusako.

source: God, what goals do you want me to work and save money for?
target: Katonda, Bilubilirwa ki by'oyagala nkolelele era ntelekere?

source: God, where do I waste money?
target: Katonda, Ludawa wensasanyiza sente mububi?

source: Receiving and giving
target: Okufunna n'okugaba

source: God says that He is a good father who cares for us. We may doubt this, but the reality is that He cares better for us than we could. Everything that we have we received from God, so there are many reasons to be thankful to Him.
target: Katonda agamba nti ali Taata omulunji afaayo gyetuli. Tuyinza okubusabusa kinno, naye ekyadala kilinti Afaayo okusinga ffe bwetuyinza okwefaako. Bulikimu kyetuyina twakifuna kuva eri Katonda, n'olw'ekyo waliwo ensonga nyinji nyo okumwebaza.

source: We all started our lives as little babies who were only receiving. God wants us to grow up and learn to take responsibility for our own lives and for others. This means sharing what we have been given and investing in what God wants. Just as God loves to give, He wants us to love giving and being generous as well!
target: Ffena twatandika obulamu bwaffe mubutto nga tuwebwa buwebwa. Katonda ayagala tukule era tuyige okutwala obuvunanyizibwa obw'obulamu bwaffe era n'obwabalala. Kinno kitegeza okugabana ekyo kyetuweledwa era n'okusiga mw'ekyo Katonda ky'ayagala. Nga Katonda bw'ayagala okugaba, Ayagala twagale okugaba era nga tukikola mudembe!

source: Talk with your friends and your trainer about how you can invest into God’s Kingdom.
target: Yogerako ne mukwano go oba omuyigiliza wo kungeriki gy'oyinza okusiga mubwakabaka bwa Katonda.

source: My goals
target: Ebilubililwa byange

source: God, which of these topics do you want to talk with me specifically about?
target: Katonda, kiiki ku milamwa gyinno gy'oyagala okogerako nange?

source: Set goals on how you will put into practice what God showed you today. Ask a good trainer for support in that. Look for someone who is transparent, wise and not just selling products.
target: Tekateka ebilubililwa mungeri ki gy'ogenda okuteka munkola ekyo Katonda ky'akulaze leero. Saaba omutendesi omulunji okuyimilila naawe mw'ekyo. Nonya omuntu omw'eluffu, omugezi era atalikumulamwa gwa kutunda byamaguzi.

source: The biggest hindrances in learning to deal with money in a good way are often to be found in our hearts. To become free, go through the worksheets “Confessing Sins and Repenting” and “Getting Rid of Colored Lenses” together with a helper. (Start with the question: “God, through which glasses do I see money?”)
target: Ebizibu ebisinga ebili mu kuyiga okukwasaganya sente mungeri enunji zakusangibwa ebisera ebisinga mumitima gyaffe. Okufuka owedembe,sooma kububaka bunno "Okwatula ebibi n'okwenenya" ne "Okwegobako endabilwamu ezisigidwa lanji" nga oliwamu n'omuyambi wo.(Tandika n'ekibuzzo:"Katonda, ndabilwamu ki mwendaba sente?")
